title: Anastasia Labs - Smart Contract Formal Verification Framework

ms.promise: Basic CEK machine implementation in Coq.
ms.criteria:
・The project is available in a public repo, continuous integration is running and a simple example uplc program (not a fully working validator) can be evaluated.
・Video explaining the current milestone output(s) is created
ms.report:
We are happy to submit Milestone 1 with basic CEK machine implementation in Coq.
We are submitting our repo which has continuous integration is running and a simple example UPLC program can be evaluated.
We also have a video explaining the outputs for easier review by the community.
Link to the repo: https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/formal-verification
Video explanation: https://youtu.be/srEPiyU8jQI
